Markets.title: Global Market: Japan bond yields edge higher ahead of key central bank meetings
Markets.summary: Japanese government bond yields rose slightly as investors awaited upcoming policy meetings by the Bank of Japan and the US Federal Reserve. Markets anticipated that both central banks would leave interest rates unchanged while searching for clues regarding future rate hikes, inflation, and economic growth.

Markets.title: Tonbo Imaging shares soar another 17% after a 64% listing pop. Buy, sell or hold the stock?
Markets.summary: Tonbo Imaging shares surged an additional 17% following an initial 64% listing pop driven by heavy demand for its IPO. Investors are now monitoring the defense electronics company's revenue growth, order execution, profitability, and cash flows to evaluate its long-term prospects.

Markets.title: $7.7 trillion AI bet: Can hyperscalers earn enough to justify the spending?
Markets.summary: Six major hyperscalers are projected to spend $7.7 trillion on AI between 2026 and 2030. UBS estimates these companies will need $1 trillion in additional earnings by 2031 to justify the investment.

Markets.title: Jio’s record India IPO falls short of record payday for bankers
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms raised $3.1 billion in India's largest-ever initial public offering. Intense competition among investment banks kept their fee percentage relatively low at about 0.65%.

Markets.title: Oil, US Treasuries prop up Indian bonds
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds rose in early trading as declining oil prices provided relief to the debt market. Despite this increase, benchmark yields have remained elevated due to foreign investors selling substantial amounts of debt since August amid inflation concerns.

Markets.title: Big Tech Earnings Week: Will AI spending pay off?
Markets.summary: Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon are reporting quarterly earnings this week to show investors how artificial intelligence spending is performing. Investors will evaluate cloud growth, profit margins, and infrastructure investments to determine if the surging demand for AI justifies the massive costs.

Geo-Political.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
Geo-Political.summary: Serbia's long-serving populist leader, Aleksandar Vučić, has conceded defeat in a pivotal national election following a student-led protest movement. Crowds in Serbia celebrated the ousting of the veteran ruler after his party lost the vote.

Geo-Political.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado has returned to the country following months in exile. Her return comes a month after the United States government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

Geo-Political.title: Deeply divided Israel braces for pivotal election
Geo-Political.summary: Israel is bracing for a pivotal national election following three years of regional conflict. The country faces this crucial political battle while remaining deeply divided.

Geo-Political.title: Australian murderer loses bid to eat Vegemite in prison
Geo-Political.summary: Convicted murderer Andre McKechnie lost a legal bid to consume Vegemite in prison. He had argued that eating the spread was his right as part of Australian culture.

Geo-Political.title: Suspect in deadly Paris suburb shooting sent for psychiatric observation
Geo-Political.summary: The suspect in a deadly Paris suburb shooting has been sent for psychiatric observation. Authorities will evaluate his mental health to determine if he is fit to continue interrogation.

Geo-Political.title: Russia to host first Olympic federation world event since Ukraine invasion
Geo-Political.summary: The International Weightlifting Federation has chosen Russia to host an upcoming world championships. This makes it the first Olympic federation to hold a world event in the country since the invasion of Ukraine.

Data & Insights.title: The long shadow of ‘zombie firms’ on India Inc, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Although the share of listed Indian zombie firms unable to service their debt has declined since peaking during the pandemic, accumulated financial stress remains high. This lingering distress prevents the recent reduction in unprofitable companies from making a significant positive impact on corporate India.

Data & Insights.title: Yen turns into better hedge against AI-driven market shock, thanks to Japan’s policy backdrop changes: Goldman Sachs
Data & Insights.summary: Goldman Sachs states that the Japanese yen is now a better hedge against potential AI-driven market shocks. This improved effectiveness is due to recent changes in Japan's policy backdrop that reduce the currency's vulnerability to rising global yields.

Data & Insights.title: Centre extends AIF scheme to boost farm infrastructure investments
Data & Insights.summary: The government has extended the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027, to support farm-sector projects. The scheme provides subsidized loans and credit guarantees for facilities like warehouses and cold storages to reduce crop losses.

Data & Insights.title: The week ahead in numbers: Govt’s H1 fiscal data, factory output, HUL Q2 earnings
Data & Insights.summary: The upcoming week features key economic updates, including the Indian government's first-half fiscal data and factory output figures. Markets will also closely monitor the second-quarter earnings report from Hindustan Unilever (HUL).

Data & Insights.title: France’s debt crisis explained: Could it trigger another euro zone meltdown?
Data & Insights.summary: France is facing a growing debt crisis driven by contracting economic activity, rising borrowing risks, and protests that are harming business confidence and public finances. These financial troubles have raised concerns about a potential economic meltdown across the entire euro zone.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: Experts state that India must expand its battery storage and modernise its power grid to meet its goal of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030. As of July 31, 2026, the country has already installed 300.50 GW of this capacity.

India.title: What Would Nikhil Kamath Do If Zerodha Disappeared? His Answer
India.summary: Zerodha co-founder Nikhil Kamath stated that he would pursue content creation if his brokerage firm ever disappeared. This hypothetical scenario highlights his alternative career interest outside the financial services sector.

India.title: NCERT To Organise Five-Day Online Series On Understanding Down Syndrome From October 26
India.summary: The NCERT and CIET are organizing a five-day online training session on understanding Down Syndrome. The educational programme begins today, October 26, and runs through October 30, 2026.

India.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Files Police Complaint Against Congress MPs For Trespassing During Stir
India.summary: Jamia Millia Islamia filed a police complaint against Congress MPs for trespassing during a student protest. The Delhi Police did not respond to the complaint or to allegations that several students were detained outside Gate 7.

India.title: Bihar Board Extends Class 9, 11 Registration Deadline for 2028 Exams
India.summary: The Bihar School Examination Board has extended the registration deadline for the 2028 Class 9 and Class 11 exams. Students now have until November 6, 2026, to complete their registration.

India.title: Over 340 Voter ID Cards Found On Narmada Riverbank In Madhya Pradesh
India.summary: Over 340 voter ID cards were discovered on the Narmada riverbank in Madhya Pradesh. The Congress party has requested a river search by divers to find additional cards.
